magic_links_subject_check.name: magic_links_subject_check
magic_links_subject_check.value:
("magic_links"."kind" = 'worker' and "magic_links"."worker_id" is not null and "magic_links"."office_user_id" is null)
     or ("magic_links"."kind" = 'office' and "magic_links"."office_user_id" is not null and "magic_links"."worker_id" is null)

sessions_subject_check.name: sessions_subject_check
sessions_subject_check.value:
("sessions"."kind" = 'worker' and "sessions"."worker_id" is not null and "sessions"."office_user_id" is null)
     or ("sessions"."kind" = 'office' and "sessions"."office_user_id" is not null and "sessions"."worker_id" is null)

messages_from_e164.name: messages_from_e164
messages_from_e164.value:
("messages"."from_e164" is not null and "messages"."from_e164" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
        or ("messages"."from_e164" is null and "messages"."channel" = 'voice' and "messages"."direction" = 'in')

messages_twilio_opt_out.name: messages_twilio_opt_out
messages_twilio_opt_out.value:
"messages"."twilio_opt_out" is null
        or ("messages"."twilio_opt_out" in ('stop', 'start') and "messages"."channel" = 'sms' and "messages"."direction" = 'in')

messages_direction_fields.name: messages_direction_fields
messages_direction_fields.value:
("messages"."direction" = 'in' and "messages"."reply_to" is null)
        or ("messages"."direction" = 'out' and "messages"."handled_as" is null and "messages"."handled_at" is null)

credentials_expiry_warned_days.name: credentials_expiry_warned_days
credentials_expiry_warned_days.value: ("credentials"."expiry_warned_for" is null) = ("credentials"."expiry_warned_days" is null) and "credentials"."expiry_warned_days" in (30, 14, 7)

credentials_check_state_check.name: credentials_check_state_check
credentials_check_state_check.value:
"credentials"."check_state" in ('verified', 'waiting', 'rejected')
        and ("credentials"."check_state" = 'rejected') = ("credentials"."rejected_reason" is not null)
        and ("credentials"."rejected_reason" is null or "credentials"."rejected_reason" in ('blurry', 'wrong_document', 'expired', 'doesnt_match', 'other'))

uploads_checked.name: uploads_checked
uploads_checked.value:
("uploads"."status" = 'waiting') = ("uploads"."checked_at" is null)
        and ("uploads"."status" = 'waiting') = ("uploads"."checked_by" is null)
        and ("uploads"."status" = 'rejected') = ("uploads"."reject_reason" is not null)
        and ("uploads"."reject_reason" is null or "uploads"."reject_reason" in ('blurry', 'wrong_document', 'expired', 'doesnt_match', 'other'))

workers_erased.name: workers_erased
workers_erased.value:
("workers"."erased_at" is null and "workers"."mobile_e164" is not null)
        or ("workers"."erased_at" is not null and "workers"."mobile_e164" is null and "workers"."email" is null
          and "workers"."external_ref" is null and "workers"."first_name" = 'Deleted' and "workers"."last_name" = 'worker'
          and "workers"."status" = 'inactive' and "workers"."roles" = '{}' and "workers"."sms_opted_out_at" is null)

pay_queries_details_length.name: pay_queries_details_length
pay_queries_details_length.value: "pay_queries"."details" is null or char_length("pay_queries"."details") between 1 and 1000

pay_queries_resolution.name: pay_queries_resolution
pay_queries_resolution.value:
"pay_queries"."status" = 'resolved'
        or ("pay_queries"."resolved_at" is null and "pay_queries"."resolved_by" is null and "pay_queries"."resolution_note" is null)

assignments_one_live_per_worker.name: assignments_one_live_per_worker
assignments_one_live_per_worker.where: worker_id is not null and status not in ('cancelled_worker', 'cancelled_firm')

assignments_confirmed_at_set.name: assignments_confirmed_at_set
assignments_confirmed_at_set.value: "assignments"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'no_show', 'completed') or "assignments"."confirmed_at" is not null

assignments_cancel_evidence.name: assignments_cancel_evidence
assignments_cancel_evidence.value:
"assignments"."status" not in ('cancelled_worker', 'cancelled_firm')
        or ("assignments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "assignments"."notice_hours" is not null
            and "assignments"."cancel_reason" is not null and length(btrim("assignments"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

assignments_strike_warning.name: assignments_strike_warning
assignments_strike_warning.value:
("assignments"."strike_warning_version" is null) = ("assignments"."strike_warning_shown_at" is null)
        and ("assignments"."strike_warning_version" is null
             or ("assignments"."status" = 'cancelled_worker' and length("assignments"."strike_warning_version") between 1 and 40))

credential_rules_required_types_format.name: credential_rules_required_types_format
credential_rules_required_types_format.value:
coalesce(array_ndims("credential_rules"."required_types"), 1) = 1
        and array_position("credential_rules"."required_types", null) is null
        and (cardinality("credential_rules"."required_types") = 0
          or (array_to_string("credential_rules"."required_types", ',') ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(,[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)*$'
            and cardinality(string_to_array(array_to_string("credential_rules"."required_types", ','), ','))
              = cardinality("credential_rules"."required_types")))

credential_rules_any_of_types_format.name: credential_rules_any_of_types_format
credential_rules_any_of_types_format.value:
coalesce(array_ndims("credential_rules"."any_of_types"), 1) = 1
    and array_position("credential_rules"."any_of_types", null) is null
    and (cardinality("credential_rules"."any_of_types") = 0
      or (array_to_string("credential_rules"."any_of_types", ',') ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(,[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)*$'
        and cardinality(string_to_array(array_to_string("credential_rules"."any_of_types", ','), ','))
          = cardinality("credential_rules"."any_of_types"))) and cardinality("credential_rules"."any_of_types") <> 1
        and not ("credential_rules"."any_of_types" && "credential_rules"."required_types")

name_map_outside_name_format.name: name_map_outside_name_format
name_map_outside_name_format.value:
char_length("name_map"."outside_name") between 1 and 200
          and "name_map"."outside_name" = lower("name_map"."outside_name")
          and "name_map"."outside_name" !~ '^ | $|  |[[:cntrl:]]'

name_map_code_format.name: name_map_code_format
name_map_code_format.value:
"name_map"."code" is null or (case when "name_map"."kind" = 'role' then "name_map"."code" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'
          else "name_map"."code" ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,49}$' end)

name_map_pay_rate_role_only.name: name_map_pay_rate_role_only
name_map_pay_rate_role_only.value:
"name_map"."pay_rate_pence" is null
          or ("name_map"."kind" = 'role' and "name_map"."code" is not null and "name_map"."pay_rate_pence" between 0 and 100000)

requests_shift_required.name: requests_shift_required
requests_shift_required.value: "requests"."type" not in ('time_change', 'swap', 'review') or "requests"."shift_id" is not null

requests_resolution.name: requests_resolution
requests_resolution.value:
("requests"."status" in ('open', 'escalated') and "requests"."resolved_at" is null and "requests"."resolved_by" is null)
        or ("requests"."status" = 'auto_resolved' and "requests"."resolved_at" is not null)
        or ("requests"."status" in ('approved', 'declined') and "requests"."resolved_at" is not null and "requests"."resolved_by" is not null)

requests_resolution_note.name: requests_resolution_note
requests_resolution_note.value:
"requests"."resolution_note" is null
        or ("requests"."status" in ('approved', 'declined') and char_length("requests"."resolution_note") between 1 and 500)

shift_events_planner_ref_length.name: shift_events_planner_ref_length
shift_events_planner_ref_length.value: "shift_events"."planner_ref" is null or char_length("shift_events"."planner_ref") between 1 and 200

shifts_post_length.name: shifts_post_length
shifts_post_length.value: "shifts"."post" is null or char_length("shifts"."post") between 1 and 200

shifts_meeting_point_length.name: shifts_meeting_point_length
shifts_meeting_point_length.value: "shifts"."meeting_point" is null or char_length("shifts"."meeting_point") between 1 and 300

shifts_uniform_length.name: shifts_uniform_length
shifts_uniform_length.value: "shifts"."uniform" is null or char_length("shifts"."uniform") between 1 and 300

shifts_required_credentials_format.name: shifts_required_credentials_format
shifts_required_credentials_format.value:
coalesce(array_ndims("shifts"."required_credentials"), 1) = 1
    and array_position("shifts"."required_credentials", null) is null
    and (cardinality("shifts"."required_credentials") = 0
      or (array_to_string("shifts"."required_credentials", ',') ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(,[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)*$'
        and cardinality(string_to_array(array_to_string("shifts"."required_credentials", ','), ','))
          = cardinality("shifts"."required_credentials")))
        and cardinality("shifts"."required_credentials") <= 20

strikes_withdrawn_together.name: strikes_withdrawn_together
strikes_withdrawn_together.value:
("strikes"."status" = 'withdrawn') = ("strikes"."withdrawn_at" is not null)
        and ("strikes"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("strikes"."withdrawn_by" is null)
        and ("strikes"."withdrawn_reason" is null or length("strikes"."withdrawn_reason") between 1 and 500)
